# Park Place LTD (concept by Kerblabs)

> Independently owned dealership founded in 1987 in Bellevue, WA, with a Boise, ID location. Facts from parkplaceltd.com. This is a free concept, not their official site.

- Bellevue: 1880 136th Pl NE, Bellevue, WA 98005, 425-562-1000
- Boise: 10990 W Fairview Ave, Boise, ID, 208-996-8166
- Website: https://www.parkplaceltd.com
- Founded: 1987
- Facilities: over 40,000 sq ft of indoor showrooms, 15-bay service center

## Marques
- Aston Martin (exclusive regional dealer)
- Lotus (exclusive regional dealer)
- Porsche (pre-owned)
- Karma (new models)
- Various exotic, luxury and collectible automobiles

## Services
- New and used vehicle sales
- Vehicle consignment
- Auto financing
- Paint protection
- Extended warranties
- Worldwide shipping
- European auto service and repair
- Auto salon with hand car wash
- Event space rental
